bead.bead_why: the near jamb steps monotonically from lining 0.76 up to frame face 1.16 with no overshoot; the far jamb has no recess at all, so there is no arris to catch light

cast.cast_note: dark line where the frame box meets the hacked-out wall on the camera-near side

head_shadow.head_shadow_note: barely present - the soffit is lit almost as brightly as the leaf (head_tone 0.92) and the junction only drops to 0.97

threshold.threshold_why: no threshold fitted: broken concrete and rubble come up to the leaf, the site is unfinished

window.shape: tall rectangle, upper three-fifths, moulded surround

peephole.peephole_why: leaf is 60 percent glazed; swept the painted field at 5x and found only the lever rose, escutcheon and panel mouldings

hinges.hinges_why: handle at x 0.95 puts the hinges on the left stile, which is buried in the 42 px lining; no knuckles project

extras: white lattice muntins with scroll motifs top and bottom of the glazing
deep white reveal box: 42 px lining on the near jamb, 91 px soffit at the head
hacked-out wall opening with exposed conduit and loose wiring beside the frame
notes: Camera sits right of the door axis, so only the left jamb shows a lining (42 px at tone 0.76) while the right jamb shows a 3 px joint straight onto the frame face - near_w/far_w is 11:1 here, the most asymmetric of the ten. Geometric midpoint falls on glass; colour taken on the left stile at the same height (250,788). Very flat tone profile (contrast 1.08) - overcast light, no gradient down the leaf.
